summary: Restructured the ask-user extension from a workspace package into a per-extension directory under pi-extensions/, added a bun-runnable build script that emits sibling .web.js bundles via the existing web-extension bundler, and began migrating tests away from the static builtin — but ran into a failing test setup and stopped mid-debug.
decisions: Move pi-extensions into per-extension dirs (e.g. pi-extensions/ask-user) with optional src/web/index.ts, so the existing buildWebExtension(packageDir, outFile) bundler can be reused.
Emit sibling bundles as pi-extensions/<name>.web.js instead of embedding them in the sidecar build.
Add a root script scripts/build-pi-extensions.ts wired as `pi-extensions:build` in package.json and run it with bun (not tsx), because the bundler uses top-level await under CJS.
Remove the static ask-user builtin from the app registry so ask-user loads at runtime like a third-party extension (drop @gizmo/ask-user workspace dep and registry import).

In ask-user.test.ts, register ask-user inside beforeEach (guarded by extension('ask-user') check) rather than beforeAll, because apps/app/src/test/setup.ts re-registers unity in a beforeEach that resets installed each test.
errors: bun scripts/build-pi-extensions.ts initially failed under npx tsx with "Top-level await is currently not supported with the cjs output format" from esbuild; fixed by switching the script invocation to bun.

ask-user.test.ts failed: after a successful beforeAll registration, the it() body showed installed ids as [svelte, git, activity, unity] — ask-user gone and unity present. Root cause: apps/app/src/test/setup.ts calls registerWebExtensions([unityWebExtension]) in a beforeEach that replaces installed each test, wiping the beforeAll-registered ask-user.

Final vitest run reported "Test Files 1 failed (1) / Tests no tests" after the beforeAll→beforeEach rewrite; the rewrite appears to have removed/left zero tests in the file — not yet resolved in this segment.
